Example Foundation Master's Scholarship 2027/28

The Example Foundation offers up to 20 fully funded scholarships for one-year master's programmes at universities in the United Kingdom and Sweden.

Eligibility: Applicants must hold citizenship of Taiwan, Japan or South Korea and a bachelor's degree with a minimum GPA of 3.3 out of 4.0.

Funding: full tuition fees and a monthly stipend of GBP 1,400.

Applications must be submitted by 15 January 2027, 23:59 CET.
